_README: Source for the edha-items Item compendium (§9h, 2026-07-18). ONLY Edha-specific objects live here — mundane gear comes from the system's cosmere-rpg.items pack (the Outlaw Longsword precedent). Schema per entry: name, type (weapon|equipment|loot), img (must exist under Foundry public/icons — a 404 is an invisible icon), description (HTML; for clue objects derive it from the session script/canon — no new lore without a lore-forge ruling). Weapon-only fields: skill (lwp|hwp), category (light_wpn|heavy_wpn), damage (PC-shaped formula, e.g. "1d6" — the system adds the wielder's mod; NOT the adversary flat +N form), damageType, range ("melee" or "Range N ft."), weightLb. NO price fields until the W25 currency canon lands (validate.js enforces — no placeholder coin names). Build: scripts/foundry-build.js (scope all|items) → packs/edha-items; docs get deterministic ids, so world copies survive rebuilds by id. World copies dragged from the pack are fully editable in Foundry; pack copies are regenerated from THIS file.

items.name: Malcurr-Stamped Shortsword
items.description:
Damage 1d6 keen; Range Melee; Type Light Weapon; Weapons Skill Light Weaponry;

A fresh-forged shortsword of far better make than the starving irregulars carrying it should own — new, uniform issue, nothing scavenged about it. The base of the blade bears a Malcurr maker's stamp: mountain-forge work, not Corvaine issue.

A DC 12 Perception test notices the stamp; a DC 13 Crafting or Lore test places the forge. Someone is arming these raiders — and the trail points north.
